title: Variants
has_variants_toggle: This product has variants (e.g., different colors, sizes)
has_variants_help: Pick the attributes the product varies by (Color, Size) — NOT the kind of product (that's Category, above). The matrix below generates one variant per combination of values you pick.
select_attributes: Select up to 3 attributes for this product
default_price_help: Pre-fills every variant. You can override per-variant below.
default_opening_cost_help: Required when any variant below has Opening qty > 0. Same cost applies to every variant you're seeding with stock.
no_values_yet: No values yet. Define this attribute's values in Settings → Variant Attributes.

errors.max_3_attributes: A product can have at most 3 attributes.
errors.attribute_not_in_shop: This attribute isn't defined for your shop. Create it in Settings.
errors.variant_in_use_cannot_edit_attributes: This variant has transaction history; attributes can't be changed.
errors.attribute_composition_mismatch: The new variant's attributes don't match the product's existing variants.
errors.need_at_least_one_attribute: Pick at least one attribute from the dropdown to generate variants.
errors.need_values_for_each_attribute: Click the value chips (Red, S, etc.) below each attribute to fill in the matrix. If an attribute has no values yet, add them in Settings → Variant Attributes first.
errors.need_at_least_one_combination: Select at least one combination to create.
errors.opening_cost_required: Some variants have Opening qty > 0 — enter an Opening cost per unit above.
errors.opening_cost_must_be_positive: Opening cost per unit must be greater than 0 when seeding stock.
